posts.title: This is Cosmic Plates, a print project for Artemis II footage
posts.description: Cosmic Plates is a little site I made to host print-ready poster layouts of space footage in the public domain. Starting with the Artemis II mission.

posts.title: I build a 3D Gaussian Splat viewer and generator with Apple's new code
posts.description: In December, Apple published Sharp, a technique for generating 3D Gaussian Splats from a single photograph. With that, I've built a set of tools to generate 3D Gaussian Splats on the fly for my blog posts using hosted ML systems, custom frontend renderer and CMS widgets.

posts.title: Breaking MindAR out of its cage (and sharing it with you)
posts.description: Why I revamped a popular, but complex, AR image tracking library to be a better performing and decoupled, free alternative to 8th Walls now de-funded engine.
